draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.47, the 10th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 2nd of 36 at WR. He went 20th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Amon-Ra St. Brown. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2025) ranked 2nd in receiving yards among the 36 WRs in his class with stats.
